subject: BRIAN: run the NotebookLM claims verification (CV-01..CV-05)
description:
Briefing pack ready at 06_thesis_writing/notebookLM/04-Claims_Verification/ following the existing 01-/02- convention: 00-MASTER-verification-brief.md, 01-HOW-TO-RUN.md, 'NLM Review/' for output, 'Candidate Sources/' for PDFs.

TWO notebooks, not one: A = CV-01/CV-02 (statistical thresholds, needs statistics literature); B = CV-03/CV-04/CV-05 (specific documents: Danish shop-hours law, XGBoost docs, Store Bededag act). Mixing them makes a statistics question retrievable against a shop-hours law.

If only one run: do A. CV-01 and CV-02 are the two that appear as numbers in a results appendix.

Do NOT upload thesis chapters -- the claim text is already quoted in the brief, and uploading our own prose lets the notebook return our wording as a source, which is the exact failure that created CV-01.

Outcomes go to writing-notes/unverified-claims-to-check.md (source of truth); raw NLM output to 'NLM Review/'. Supersedes task 20.
